Metadata.title: TorFinder — Find BMA Software TORs
Metadata.description: A platform to collect, analyze, and match Bangkok Metropolitan Administration software TOR announcements.

Footer.descriptionLine1: A platform to search and analyze

LandingHero.description: Automatically collect, analyze, and match TORs from BMA agencies with your company. No more checking e-GP every day.

LandingFeatures.heading: A platform built for both business and government
LandingFeatures.subheading: The system works automatically from data collection to notifications, reducing the burden on companies while increasing transparency for government.
LandingFeatures.collectDescription: Automatically pulls and filters software procurement announcements from e-GP and BMA agencies, with duplicate detection.
LandingFeatures.aiDescription: Vertex AI helps analyze and extract key details such as scope of work, qualifications, and budget, so you don't have to read through PDFs one by one.
LandingFeatures.matchDescription: Compares TOR requirements against your company profile and notifies you instantly when a suitable project appears (Match Score).
LandingFeatures.transparencyDescription: Lets the public search project data and helps the OAG detect price irregularities and below-standard competition more easily.

LandingSteps.heading: Get started in 3 steps
LandingSteps.subheading: Simple, fast, no technical knowledge required
LandingSteps.step1Description: Specify your technology skills, company size, and expertise. Takes less than 5 minutes.
LandingSteps.step2Description: The system scans new TORs daily, compares them to your profile, and calculates a fit score.
LandingSteps.step3Description: Receive alerts, review details already summarized by AI, and submit your proposal ahead of competitors.

LandingCta.heading: Ready to get started?
LandingCta.description: Join the software companies already using TorFinder and never miss a BMA procurement opportunity again.

LandingPreview.heading: Search and review TORs transparently
LandingPreview.description: The system lets the public and software companies freely search BMA projects, review prices, and submit feedback during the public hearing (Draft) period instantly.
LandingPreview.searchPlaceholder: Search by project name or agency name...
LandingPreview.feedbackPlaceholder: Enter your suggestions, concerns, or comments to help increase transparency...
LandingPreview.viewPublicPortal: Go to Public Portal to search all projects

LandingExplorer.heading: See exactly why a TOR fits you
LandingExplorer.description: TorFinder reads each TOR's bidder qualifications and checks them against your company profile. Hover a requirement to see how it scores.
